notes: ἐντελεῖται heads on *charge* rather than *give*: no English word glosses ἐντέλλομαι separately and *give* is the light verb (rules 17, 91); the unit is discontinuous around *his angels* without absorbing them (rule 15).
*up* is kept with ἀροῦσίν rather than treated as a separate unit; no source token stands to answer to it and it governs no phrase (rule 36).
Τοῖς and τὸν are emptied by αὐτοῦ and σου respectively (rule 20), while the anarthrous χειρῶν keeps its supplied *their* as an ordinary helper.
ὅτι is recitative and left unrepresented, the quotation being marked by punctuation alone (rule 43).
